title: Arte y Expresion
welcome_lead: Human Ingenuity covers art, music, literature. The Hispanic world has given Picasso, Frida, Garcia Lorca, and more.
meta_desc: Spanish: art, music, literature, Hispanic creative tradition.
final_note: El arte necesita lengua — hablarlo es prolongarlo.

walkthroughs.body_html: En primer plano, al fondo. El artista usa colores intensos. La obra evoca + emotion.
Painted 1937 in response to bombing during Spanish Civil War. Monochrome, fragmented — Cubist anti-war manifesto.
Diego Rivera, David Siqueiros, Jose Clemente Orozco. Post-revolution Mexico — art for the people, on public walls.
